scope: saved straight modes and one active stiffness derivative; no prefix searches
recovery: minimal column equilibration before SVD in the ORIGINAL centered fundamental basis; physical evaluator unchanged
basis_diagnostic: bounded spatial eigenvector columns of unchanged H, comparison only; not required for accepted recovery

derivative.local_halfwidth_rule: min(saved isolation margin, saved nearest-mode gap/4, max(10*predicted_abs_frequency_shift,1e-8))
derivative.rationale: Inherited 1e-5 derivative tolerance. Central difference delta^2=1e-8; omega~.69 and predicted slope~4e-4 give conservative solver-error amplification <4e-7 relative with xtol1e-14. Record actual error bounds and decimal-rounding effects.

straight_refinement.allowed_only_if: same-frequency bounded recovery and high-precision diagnostic establish root error as the remaining cause

failure_policy: Retain original physical tolerances. No extra angles, modes, basis sweeps, interval enlargement, new physical model or damping.
